title: Fractional distillation of crude oil
caption: Crude oil is vaporised and enters near the bottom of a column that is hot at the bottom and cooler at the top. Each fraction condenses where the temperature falls below its boiling range: the shortest molecules, with the lowest boiling points, rise furthest.
alt: A tall column with outlets at different heights: refinery gases at the top, then petrol, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, fuel oil, and bitumen at the bottom.
